name: E. coli RNA polymerase σ70 holoenzyme (α2ββ′ωσ70)

source.title: Cryo-EM structure of E. coli RNAP sigma70 holoenzyme
source.license: CC0 1.0 Universal: wwPDB archive data are free of copyright restrictions (https://www.wwpdb.org/about/usage-policies)

superposition.method: least-squares (quaternion) on beta' Calpha atoms matched by label_seq_id

notes: Generated by tools/build-assets.mjs from the mmCIF file pinned in tools/sources.lock.json (model 1, altloc . or A, no hydrogens).

Coordinates are placed in the rnap-ec frame by one rigid superposition on beta' Calpha atoms (1334 atoms, RMSD 2.37 A). The holoenzyme is a different structure: domains that move between holoenzyme and elongation complex (for example the clamp) do not coincide with rnap-ec.
activeSite anchor: MG ion (label_asym G, auth D 2001); 1.74 A from the rnap-ec activeSite after superposition.
L0: one envelope per part (Gaussian density of Calpha beads, sigma 5 A, marching cubes); L2 radius 12 A around activeSite.
No DNA or RNA in this entry, so there are no tracks; dnaEntry, dnaExit and rnaExit anchors are not defined for this asset.
